Rules.InvariantScript:
Text(
    Sum(
        Filter(
            colMyRequests,
            Year(StartDate) = Year(Today()) &&
            ApprovalStatus_1 <> "Rejected" &&
            Type_of_leave = "Vacation Paid"
        ),
        Days
    )
)
If(App.Width < 680, "No leave requests yet. Tap the + button to submit time off.", "No leave requests yet. Use New request to submit time off.")

If(ThisItem.StartDate = ThisItem.EndDate, Text(ThisItem.StartDate, "mmm d") & If(Coalesce(Value(ThisItem.Days), 0) < 1, " · " & Coalesce(Text(ThisItem.Leave_Time), ""), ""), Text(ThisItem.StartDate, "mmm d") & " – " & Text(ThisItem.EndDate, "mmm d")) & " · " & Text(ThisItem.Days) & If(Coalesce(Value(ThisItem.Days), 0) = 1, " day", " days")
["Vacation Paid", "Vacation Unpaid", "Sick Leave Paid", "Sick Leave Unpaid", "Bereavement", "Jury Duty", "Personal Day", "Stat. Holiday"]
varDetailDates & " · " & Text(varDetailDays) & If(varDetailDays = 1, " day", " days") & " · " & Coalesce(varDetailStatus, "")
If(IsBlank(varDetailApproverComments) || Len(Trim(varDetailApproverComments)) = 0, "No approver comments yet.", varDetailApproverComments)
